model_compatibility.reason: Its shock inputs describe the PAST 5 sessions. A slider describing a hypothetical future move cannot be fed into them without changing their meaning; on the 2023-2026 test it does not beat the zero or training-mean baselines.

Inputs are trailing 5-session moves; a hypothetical shock can only be read as 'the shock already happened last week', which excludes the immediate reaction. The model also shows no skill: its test MAE is not distinguishable from the zero-return baseline.
